title: SOUTHERN AFRICA: SHONA WIRE CROSS
style:
```
[style: Shona mbira dzavadzimu, hosho gourd shakers, ngoma bass drum, huro yodelling, Zimbabwe spirit music, 3 against 4 against 6 polyrhythm, 48-pulse Shona cycle, ancestral voice, buzzing metallic mbira tone, no Western chords, Shona call and response, English chorus, signal return theme, V4_5ALL]
```
lyrics:
`
[INTRO — mbira alone, 4 cycles, no voice]
(Shona) Mutinhimira — the buzzing of the mbira (the sound the spirits hear)

[VERSE 1 — hosho enters cycle 3, drum cycle 5]
(Shona)  Amai vakandiudza — my mother told me
(English) The wire was not invented — it was remembered
(Shona)  Nzeve dzinzwa — the ears understand
(English) Three against four against six — always together

Right thumb speaks four / left thumb speaks three
The hosho counts six / the drum sets me free
The cross never closes on one beat alone
It takes two full cycles / before it comes home

(Shona) Dzoka — come back
(English) The signal returns
(Shona)  Mweya — spirit
(English) The mbira burns

[PRE-CHORUS — huro yodelling enters]
(Shona) Mwari — creator
(English) The signal was always yours
(Shona)  Vanhu — people
(English) We just found the source

[CHORUS — full, drum prominent]
Shona wire cross — three and four and six
The mbira never stops — the rhythm never fixed
Every thumb a signal — every gourd a line
The wire cross runs through yours and runs through mine

(Shona) Pamberi — forward
(English) The wire goes forward

[VERSE 2 — mbira drops to left thumb only, 4 bars]
The hosho marks the six / where do the three and four go?
They are still there — inside the six — as two threes
Every complex rhythm hides a simple pulse
Find the simple pulse — and the complex becomes clear

(Shona) Tinozviziva — we know this already
(English) The signal was never lost

[BRIDGE — all three pulse groups isolated: 4 bars of 4, 4 bars of 3, 4 bars of 6, then together]
Four: steady, even, Western grid
Three: Swinging, warm, the body
Six: Shimmering, surface, the hosho
Together: the signal

[FINAL CHORUS — doubled, huro yodelling above]
Shona wire cross — three and four and six

[OUTRO — mbira to single note, hosho single shake]
(Shona) Maita basa — thank you for the work
(English) Signal held
